title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: I've got a permanent mooring in 1500 m and want to check fatigue on the most-loaded line. Can you screen it?

Glad to help — a few details so I screen it the right way:
  • Line make-up — chain, wire, or both (and the cross-sections)?
  • Do you have a tension-range histogram (ranges + cycle counts), or should I build one from a storm spectrum?
  • Design life and the fatigue safety factor you work to?
I can screen metallic lines (chain/wire) directly. Synthetic rope needs a different method, so I'd flag that and pass it on.
Two segments: R4 studless chain (8,000 mm²) and spiral-strand wire (5,200 mm²). Tension-range bins for each are attached. 25-year design life, factor of 3.

Got it — both metallic, so I'll screen fatigue directly. Basis I'll use: DNV S-N curve D (seawater with cathodic protection), Miner's-rule cumulative damage, 25-yr life × factor 3 → a 75-yr requirement. Running it now…

Here's the fatigue life of each line:
LineTypeFatigue lifeRequiredVerdict
chain-01R4 studless chain2,587 yr75 yr✅ Pass · 34.5×
wire-01spiral-strand wire609 yr75 yr✅ Pass · 8.1×
Both clear the requirement comfortably — the wire is the governing line.

report.title: Mooring Fatigue Screen
report.inputs:
Lines
chain-01 — R4 studless chain · A = 8,000 mm²
wire-01 — spiral-strand wire · A = 5,200 mm²

Tension-range bins
chain-01:  220 kN ×150,000 · 300 kN ×60,000 · 380 kN ×10,000
wire-01:   180 kN ×180,000 · 260 kN ×90,000 · 360 kN ×20,000

Design
Design life 25 yr · Design fatigue factor 3 · Required life 75 yr
report.methodology:
1 · Stress range Δσ = tension range ÷ cross-sectional area, per bin.
2 · Cycles-to-failure N from the DNV S-N curve D (seawater with cathodic protection).
3 · Cumulative damage D = Σ (nᵢ / Nᵢ) — Miner's rule across all bins.
4 · Fatigue life = design life ÷ D.
5 · Verdict: life must clear design life × DFF (= 75 yr).
report.outputs:
LineΣ damageFatigue lifeDFF marginVerdict
chain-010.00972,587 yr34.5×✅ Pass
wire-010.0411609 yr8.1×✅ Pass
Verdict: PASS — both lines exceed the 75-yr requirement; wire-01 governs.
